email.name: Elena Marsh
email.subject: Arriving Friday - a few questions
email.body:
Hi there,

We're checking in this Friday (booking BR-1042) and I have a few questions:

1. We'd love to bring our dog Biscuit. She's about 30 lbs. Is that OK and what's the fee?
2. Could we check out late on Monday? I'm a Gold member.
3. Can you arrange a pickup from MIA for the two of us on Friday afternoon? Our flight lands at 2:15 PM.

Thanks so much!
Elena

record.draft:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and Biscuit on Friday 6 November for booking BR-1042.

1. Dogs: Biscuit is welcome. Dogs up to 40 lbs are allowed, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1].

2. Late checkout: Your Gold tier is noted on your booking. Late checkout on Monday 9 November falls on a weekday, so the Gold benefit applies, which is 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P7][P8]. Our front desk will confirm this with you.

3. Airport pickup: We can arrange a pickup from MIA. A sedan (up to 3 guests) is $65 one way, and bookings should be made at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. Our concierge team will contact you to confirm the booking for your 2:15 PM arrival. Please let us know if you would prefer an SUV instead ($95 one way, up to 6 guests) [P11].

The team will confirm all final details and totals with you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hi Daniel,

Thank you for your email. We look forward to welcoming you on 13 November for booking ML-2015.

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs are within the limit. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P8]. Early check-in depends on room readiness and is never guaranteed at booking [P6]. We have passed your request to our front desk, who will confirm whether an early arrival is possible and any fee.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P11]. An 11:00 AM pickup falls on the hour. We have sent your request for three passengers to our concierge team, who will confirm the booking with you.

The team will confirm all final details. Please reply if you have any questions.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Thank you for your email. We look forward to welcoming you on 13 November for booking ML-2015.

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs are within the limit. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P8]. Early check-in depends on room readiness and is never guaranteed at booking [P6]. We have passed your request to our front desk, who will confirm whether an early arrival is possible and any fee.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way. It runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P11]. An 11:00 AM pickup falls on the hour. We have sent your request for three passengers to our concierge team, who will confirm the booking with you.

The team will confirm all final details. Please reply if you have any questions.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

¿Puede llevar a su gato al Mountain Lodge?

record.draft:
Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva ML-2021 (Standard Queen, 20 al 22 de noviembre de 2026):

- Desayuno: sí, un desayuno continental está incluido tarifa de cada habitación. Se sirve de 7:00 a. m. a 10:00 a. m. en el Great Room. No hay restaurante ni servicio a la habitación, aunque se puede pedir comida de restaurantes locales al mostrador de recepción [P1].

- Mascotas: lamentablemente, en el Mountain Lodge solo admitimos perros; los gatos y otras mascotas no están permitidos [P4]. Lo sentimos mucho por no poder recibir a su gato.

Si tiene cualquier otra pregunta, con gusto le ayudamos.

Un saludo cordial,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Any upgrade would be confirmed by our team before it's applied to your booking.

Please also note that your booking includes a continental breakfast served daily from 7:00 to 10:00 AM in the Great Room [P3].

Warm wishes,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Thank you for writing. I've found your booking (ML-2025, Standard Queen, Fri 13 to Sun 15 Nov).

Guided hike: Guided hikes run Saturdays at 9:00 AM for $20 per person, and bookings are made at the front desk by Friday evening [P1]. We've asked our team to sign up the two of you for Saturday 14 Nov. Please also stop by the front desk on Friday evening to confirm your places.

Standard check-out is 11:00 AM [P8].

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

record.draft:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately, dogs are only welcome at Beach Resort up to 40 lbs, so a 60 lb Labrador is not permitted. Up to 2 dogs per room are allowed under that weight limit. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant. A $75 non-refundable pet fee applies per stay [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only at $45 per night with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served [P6].

There is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax, which includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P3].

If you'd like to check dates for December, please share them and we will check availability for you. Our team can also help if you have questions about other pet-friendly options.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November.

Pets: We're dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and can't be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We've passed your request to our front desk, who will confirm whether an earlier arrival is possible.

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way, and runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Bookings must be made at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We've requested a shuttle for your three guests arriving around 11 AM on Friday. Could you please send your flight number and arrival time so our team can confirm the booking?

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

record.draft:
Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva del 20 al 22 de noviembre (habitación Standard Queen, 2 noches):

- Desayuno: sí, el desayuno continental está incluido en todas las tarifas y se sirve de 7:00 a. m. a 10:00 a. m. en el Great Room [P1].
- Gato: lamentablemente, en Mountain Lodge no se permiten gatos ni otras mascotas que no sean perros [P4]. Solo aceptamos perros (máximo 2 por habitación), con una tarifa de mascota de $50 por noche por habitación, con tope de $200 por estancia [P4].

Quedamos atentos si desea otra consulta.

Saludos cordiales,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Dear Mark,

Congratulations on your 10th anniversary! Thank you for telling us.

I can't offer a free upgrade myself, but I have passed your request to our manager for review, and they will reply to you directly. Our room upgrade benefits apply to loyalty tiers [P1], and you are not currently a member. The team will confirm any total and availability before a change is made.

We look forward to welcoming you both.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Unfortunately, dogs are welcome at Beach Resort only up to 40 lbs, so a 60 lb Labrador is not permitted [P1]. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only at $45 per night, with in/out privileges [P6].

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P4].

If you have any questions, please write back and we will be happy to help with your plans.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Bookings must be made at least 12 hours ahead [P11]. Could you send your flight number and arrival time so our concierge team can confirm the 11 AM shuttle for the three of you?

Warm regards,
